title: Retrofit kit for turning a standard toilet into a graywater toilet with an integrated sink
summary: This Old House demonstrates how to convert a standard toilet into a graywater-capable unit using a retrofit kit, highlighting both a pre-made graywater toilet option and a retrofit approach. The host explains toilet anatomy (flapper, fill valve, refill tube), then shows replacing the refill tube with a clear discharge tube to divert clean supply water toward a sink on the tank and then down to refill the bowl. A spacer is introduced to accommodate different tank lengths. The segment emphasizes that both the faucet supply and the refill-to-bowl pathways carry clean water, while illustrating the practical steps to install the retrofit and integrate handwashing at the toilet unit as a usable feature.
topics: water flow path: supply to faucet
water flow path: discharge to bowl

sections.title: Toilet basics and the graywater concept
sections.description: Explanation of how a standard toilet tank operates during a flush: the flapper lifts to release water, the fill valve refills the tank, and a refill tube sends water to refill the bowl. The speaker frames the idea of a graywater toilet by noting a sink on a unit and the possibility of using a dedicated water path for handwashing connected to the toilet system.

sections.title: Product options: pre-made unit vs retrofit kit
sections.description: Introduction to two options: a complete pre-made graywater toilet unit and a retrofit kit designed to convert a standard toilet tank into a graywater setup.

sections.title: Retrofit installation step: swap refill tube for discharge tube
sections.description: Demonstrates removing the existing refill tube and replacing it with a clear plastic tube so that the clean supply water can be diverted to the sink faucet and the discharge directs water to refill the bowl.

sections.title: Tank-length compatibility: spacer
sections.description: Notes that a spacer is provided to accommodate different tank lengths, ensuring the retrofit kit can fit various toilet models.

sections.title: System operation after install: handwashing and water paths
concepts: flow through fill and bowl refill
sections.description: Concludes with the cleaned-water path: after flushing, clean water is available to wash hands via the sink, with both supply and bowl-refill paths described as clean-water sources.
